result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a promotional badge on the pizza restaurant card reading '–0%', which is a nonsensical discount value indicating a data/formatting bug. Other elements (header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, bottom nav) render correctly.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a badge labelled '–0%'. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and looks broken, suggesting a missing/null discount value being rendered instead of the badge being hidden.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or null, and ensure the badge only renders with a valid non-zero percentage (e.g. '–20%').
